visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen layout appears with a male host in a pinstriped blazer on the bottom half and a 'lost wallet' poster on the top half. The host speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and hand gestures. (2) The top screen changes to show a man with glasses (Richard Wiseman) speaking into a microphone. (3) An aerial shot of a classical building (Scottish National Gallery) in Edinburgh is shown on the top half, while the host remains on the bottom. (4) A leather wallet is placed on a cobblestone street as people walk past in the background. (5) A sequence of top-half shots shows different contents inside wallets: an empty interior, a baby photo, a dog photo, a family photo, and a charitable receipt. (6) The host takes up the full screen briefly, then a product showcase begins. Hands are seen demonstrating the 'Tiger' wallet in black, blue, and red colors. Close-up shots highlight the leather texture, the YKK zipper, and water droplets being sprayed on the surface to show water resistance. (7) Multiple internal compartments for cards, cash, and receipts are shown. A hand places a coin into a specific inner pocket labeled for a lucky charm. (8) The video returns to the split-screen format, showing photos of families and dogs with return rate percentages. (9) A celebratory confetti graphic appears over a photo of a smiling baby with '88%' text. (10) A brief clip of an older man crying from a dramatic production is shown in the top half. (11) The host returns to full screen, looking into the camera and asking a concluding question with open hand gestures.

(2) As photos are mentioned, subtle paper rustling SFX are interspersed with the speech. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into the product endorsement. The speaker's rate increases. (4) A crisp metallic zipper pull SFX occurs at ~00:26, followed by a 'pssh' liquid spray sound at ~00:28. (5) A distinct metallic clinking sound of a coin hitting leather is heard at ~00:33. (6) A digital 'pop' or celebratory ding SFX accompanies the revelation of the highest return rate at ~00:47. (7) The music continues steadily until a final rising melodic flourish and hard cut at the end of the question.
